title: Internship in Child and Adolescent Counseling
tagline: Where training becomes practice, under wise eyes.
welcome: The internship is where everything you have learned meets real children under real supervision. This course orients and sustains you through it.
vignette: In week three, an intern sits with a grieving eight-year-old and remembers every course at once, then forgets them all and simply listens well. The supervisor's note reads: presence, then technique. That is the internship's lesson.
vignette_attr: An early internship session, drawn from supervision
description: An orientation and support course for the supervised clinical placement: internship expectations and documentation, professional conduct and confidentiality on site, supervision use, reflective practice, case presentation, and self-care. It does not replace actual supervised clinical hours.
questions: How do I learn maximally from my supervisor?
How do I document and present cases professionally?
How do I sustain myself through clinical demands?
importance: Supervised hours are where competence is certified
Reflective practice turns experience into growth
Professional conduct on site protects clients and you
misconceptions: that the internship is a performance to pass, when it is a learning relationship to use
that uncertainty is weakness, when it is the raw material of supervision
figures: who walks the road with you
outcomes: You will understand hours, conduct, and evaluation.
You will write and present professionally.
You will bring questions and receive feedback well.
You will turn experience into learning.
Maintain ethics and confidentiality on site
You will practice self-care and boundary management.
tips: Bring one real question to every supervision
Write your reflection the same day
Protect rest; the work is a marathon
integration: The internship integrates and certifies the whole programme.
faith: We serve under guidance with humility, as apprentices in a sacred craft.
closing: May your placement form you well, and may the children you meet remember your steadiness.
